test_title: PYST 21: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 27 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words in the given sentence.**

Adversity always presents opportunities for __**the examination of one's own conscious thoughts and feelings**.__
solution:
The correct answer is "introspection."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **"Introspection"** refers to the process of examining one's own thoughts, feelings, and motives. (किसी के अपने विचारों, भावनाओं और उद्देश्यों की जांच करने की प्रक्रिया)

 
 
• **Example**: *After the breakup, she turned to **introspection**__ to understand her own feelings and motivations.*
 
 
 
• It involves self-reflection and introspective analysis to gain insight into oneself, one's actions, and one's experiences.
 
• So, the examination of one's own conscious thoughts and feelings is **"introspection."**
 
• The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Judgement: **the ability to form opinions or to make sensible decisions. (सम्‍मति स्थिर करने या बुद्धिमतापूर्ण निर्णय करने की योग्‍यता; निर्णय क्षमता)
 
• **Evaluation: **the process of judging or calculating the quality, importance, amount, or value of something. (किसी चीज़ की गुणवत्ता, महत्व, मात्रा या मूल्य को आंकने या गणना करने की प्रक्रिया)
 
• **Cognition: **the process by which knowledge and understanding is developed in the mind. (वह प्रक्रिया जिसके द्वारा मस्तिष्‍क में ज्ञान और बोध का विकास होता है; संज्ञान, अभिज्ञान)
